main_text.p: 2.Sam.19.19. הָעִוִּיתִי Inique feci, 2.Sam.24.17, הֶעֱוּ Per-verterunt, Jer.3.21. הָעֵוִינוּ Inique fecimus, Psalm.106.6. Infinit. הַעֲוֹת Perversè agendo, Jer.9.5. בְּהַעֲוֹתוֹ Quum perversè egerit, 2.Sam.7.17.

עֲוָעִים m.p. Perversitates, Jesa.19. v.14. ex geminatâ primâ radicali: Chaldæus, רוּחַ הַתָּעוּ Spiritum erroris. R.Salomon inquit, שֵׁם חוֹלִי שֶׁל מִירוּף הַדַּעַת esse nomen morbi abreptæ mentis. Aben Esra scribit, esse Vocem irregularem ab עָוָה.
עֲוִירָה f. Chald. Iniquitas: unde plur. וַעֲוִיָּתֶךָ Et iniquitates tuas, Dan.4.24.

עָוֹן m. Perversitas, Iniquitas: Constr. עֲוֹן, 1.Par.21. v.8. atque sic quater cum duplici ו scribitur, alias semper cum unico: Aff. עֲוֹנוֹ Iniquitatem suam, Psalm.36. v.2. Aff. בַּעֲוֹנְךָ Propter iniquitatem tuam, Hos.14.2. Plural. עֲוֹנִים: Cum Aff. עֲוֹנֶיךָ Iniquitatum tuarum, Ezech.28.18. Et cum defectu, עֲוֹנֵנוּ Iniquitates nostras, Jerem.14.7. מֵעֲוֹנֵינוּ Ab iniquitatibus nostris, Daniel.9.18. Et fœminini-num, עֲוֹנָה Iniquitates, Lev.16.21. Aff. עֲוֹנוֹתָיו Iniquitates ejus, Prov.5.22. עֲוֹנֹתַי Iniquitates meæ, Psal.38.5. Hinc juxta quosdam, לְשֶׁתֵּי עֲוֹנֹתָם Propter duas iniquitates ipsorum, Hos.10.10. nam juxta Masorethas legendum עֲוֹנוֹתָם, quod LXX. acceperunt עֲוֹנוֹתָם Iniquitates ipsorum. Vide amplius in עַיִן.

עוּ Hiph. הֶעִיז Coire, Congregari, Congregare se: Et activè, Congregare: Præt. הֶעִיזוּ Congregant se, Job.10.13. scil. ad fugam, ut R.Salomon explet. Imperat. הָעֵז אֶת מִקְנְךָ Congrega pecus tuum, Exod.9. v.19. הָעִיזוּ Congregate vos, Jer.4.6. Et defectivè, הָעוּ, Jer.6.1.
עוֹל m. Infantulus, Lactens, Fœtus, Jesa.65.20. Aff. עוּלָה Fœtus, vel Infantuli sui, Jes.49.15.

page.notes: Hebrew forms and vowel points are copied as far as the scan allows; the fine pointing in the first lines (הָעִוִּיתִי, הֶעֱוּ, הָעֵוִינוּ, הַעֲוֹת, בְּהַעֲוֹתוֹ) and in the Chaldaic and Hebrew phrases of the עָוֹן entry is uncertain and may contain errors. Hebrew entry letters at the head of each entry (עוּ, עוֹל, עָוָה, עֲוָעִים) are printed in large type; their vowel marks are not fully clear. The Hebrew "עֲוִירָה" and "וַעֲוִיָּתֶךָ" line, and the Hebrew word in "עֲוֹנֹתַי", should be checked against the scan. The italic/roman split inside several Latin glosses (e.g. "Congregare se", "Congregare") is approximate. Printed reference "Jesa.19. v.14." and "Jes.49.15." are as printed. The running head is the Hebrew letters עו, shown as printed.
